hypotheses: Hidden opponent attributes, instructions, targets, future RNG and unseen positions cannot change bounded candidates or policy decisions when observed evidence is identical.

A selects useful feasible expiring windows; H continues a supported objective with at most three dependencies and cancels contradictions; C allows trait/context-dependent discretion only among near-comparable viable options.
Recognition may change movement timing but cannot change speed, skill, physical contact or assign a pass outcome.
Selected actions, physical preparation, attempted resolution, actual release and outcome must remain separate.
Full matches must finish, save/replay must be deterministic and observers must be neutral.
blockers: stale dependency continuing after observed contradiction

performance.measure: candidate construction + policy + canonical match CPU/RSS separately
performance.interpretation: A ceiling for a future confirmation gate; exceeding it is a blocker, not grounds to weaken physics.

confirmation.prerequisite: All bounded information paths including goalkeeper/defensive/restart decisions audited; development blockers resolved before code/evaluator/config freeze.
confirmation.handling: Inconclusive evidence does not establish superiority; never tune against a frozen cohort.
